name: media-automation-lark
title: 自媒体自动化（飞书 CLI）
job_to_be_done: Feishu content automation and Lark content workflows for creators and small teams. Use it for a Lark content workflow or RSS to Feishu archiving when users want to collect RSS/API feeds and public webpages, organize articles and files, build metrics dashboards, preview locally, or optionally write reviewed results to Feishu/Lark Bitable or Docs. 适用于将 RSS/API、公开网页、文章、图片、PDF、Office 文件或平台指标整理成 Markdown、数据看板或飞书多维表格/云文档，也用于按选题采集公开内容、启动本地控制面板、配置 lark-cli 或给生成文字做 renhua 去 AI 味润色。触发词包括“自媒体自动化”“内容归档到飞书”“搜索采集”“素材管理”“数据看板”“打开面板”“用 lark-cli”。

trigger_surface.description: Feishu content automation and Lark content workflows for creators and small teams. Use it for a Lark content workflow or RSS to Feishu archiving when users want to collect RSS/API feeds and public webpages, organize articles and files, build metrics dashboards, preview locally, or optionally write reviewed results to Feishu/Lark Bitable or Docs. 适用于将 RSS/API、公开网页、文章、图片、PDF、Office 文件或平台指标整理成 Markdown、数据看板或飞书多维表格/云文档，也用于按选题采集公开内容、启动本地控制面板、配置 lark-cli 或给生成文字做 renhua 去 AI 味润色。触发词包括“自媒体自动化”“内容归档到飞书”“搜索采集”“素材管理”“数据看板”“打开面板”“用 lark-cli”。
should_trigger: 把 RSS 和公开网页采集整理成 Markdown，并按分类归档到飞书多维表格。
打开本地控制面板，检查环境并准备 lark-cli 的本地预览。
按选题搜索采集文章，生成数据看板并保存到云文档。
整理图片、PDF 和 RSS 内容到 Markdown，再按素材管理流程归档到飞书。
Set up Feishu content automation: collect RSS feeds and public web pages, create a Markdown preview, and archive approved items to Bitable.
Build a Lark content workflow for a creator team: gather articles, categorize them, and save the reviewed output to Lark Docs.
Create an RSS to Feishu flow that archives new feed items to a Bitable after a local dry run.
should_not_trigger: 只解释 RSS 是什么，不运行任何自动化流程。
把这段内容翻译成英文，不需要飞书或脚本。
只写一篇关于数据看板的说明，不执行任何采集。
Explain what RSS to Feishu means; do not run a collector or write anything.
Translate the phrase Feishu content automation into Chinese; do not use Feishu or any scripts.
Write a short definition of Lark content workflow for a glossary; no implementation.
edge_cases: 帮我解释飞书多维表格字段设计，但不做内容归档。
仅给出本地控制面板的界面建议，不启动脚本。
概述搜索采集的概念，不生成 Markdown 或调用后端。
Design a Lark content workflow architecture on paper; do not start the panel or collect data.
Compare Feishu Bitable and Lark Docs for manual editorial planning; no RSS to Feishu automation.
Suggest search keywords for RSS to Feishu tools without running a collection.
